newsitem.title: USA: Children's B'casting sues Disney, ABC.
newsitem.headline: Children's B'casting sues Disney, ABC.

text.p: Children's Broadcasting Corp said Friday that it has filed a lawsuit to stop Walt Disney Co and ABC Radio Networks Inc from allegedly trying to copy Children's Broadcasting's radio programming format and force Children's Broadcasting out of the children's radio market.
Children's Broadcasting has had a strategic relationship with ABC since 1995.
Children's Broadcasting said it is also seeking significant damages from Disney and ABC.
The suit said ABC and its new parent company Disney allegedly used the relationship between ABC and Children's Broadcasting to gain confidential business information about Children's Broadcasting.

When the two companies were working together, ABC had agreed to serve as national sales representative for Children's Broadcasting and was responsible for scheduling and billing of network commercial time on Children's Broadcasting's Radio AAHS network.
In late July, ABC Radio Networks Inc terminated its operations agreement with Children's Broadcasting.
Children's Broadcasting filed its suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Minnesota.
Walt Disney Co spokesmen were not immediately available for comment.
Children's Broadcasting's Radio AAHS has an affiliated network of 32 stations across the company, featuring a mix of music, news, stories and games for children ages 12 and under.
